scope: Pre2024 source-history research only; no model-input approval.
selection: Filter by requested issuer CIK and available_time <= decision_time; select greatest original report_end, then greatest availability time. Conflicting equal-ranked accessions reject.
older_period_amendment: Retain as its own vintage; do not displace a newer reporting period or recompute another accession's ratios.
latest_unready_filing: Return unready; never fall back to an older convenient snapshot.
staleness_clock: Original report_end to UTC decision date; amendment publication does not reset the financial period age.
unknown_issuer: Return unavailable; never substitute another CIK or today's ticker match.
returned_records: Independent copies; source history and caller state remain unchanged.
retired_source_and_decision_dates: Reject 2024 onward in this research reader.
